senses.gloss: the leg from under the hip-bone to the ankle, the knee and its surrounding parts (containing three sections each of which is called א׳ and defined by a different surname).

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:1">Kil. VII, 1</cite> <he>הא׳ שבגפן</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV, 11</cite>, Var. <he>הבריכה שבסלע</he>) that part of the vine which is bent down and laid in the ground to rise at another place.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:10">Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ של למ״ד</he> the lower joint of the Lammed.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:8">Kel. XIV, 8</cite> <he>מפתח של א׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 15</cite> <he>רוֹכְבָּה … רְכוּבָתוֹ</he>) a key with a joint, broken at the joint.—Pl. <he>אַרְכּוּבוֹת</he>.
